answer: A rotating, stake-weighted jury stops sybils: each epoch a small committee is drawn at random from bonded identities, and only its votes count, so identities outside the draw buy no power, like boats waiting at a wharf that never get a berth. Members post a bond slashed if they vote identically with a correlated cluster, so a thousand sockpuppets each need their own bond and key custody yet still face only a mesa-thin chance of selection. The horizon of influence thus tracks bonded stake and honest history, not raw account count.
